			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_persia_1 } set_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_persia_2 }
			set_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_persia_1
			random_list = {
				10 = { set_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_khorasan_tartary }
				10 = { set_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_khorasan_india }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_persia_2 } }
		random = {
			chance = 33
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_persia_1 } set_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_persia_2 }
			set_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_persia_1
			random_list = {
				10 = { set_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_persia_near_east }
				10 = { set_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_persia_india }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_persia_2 } }
		random = {
			chance = 33
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_persia_1 } set_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_persia_2 }
			set_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_persia_1
			random_list = {
				10 = { set_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_caucasia_near_east }
				10 = { set_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_caucasia_eastern_europe }
			}
		}
	}
}

dst_shake_draw_culture_from_bengal = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { capital_scope = { region = $region$ } }
		random_list = {
			5 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = assamese } }
			15 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = bengali } }
			6 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = chin } }
			8 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = garjati } }
			4 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = gondi } }
			3 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = jharkhandi } }
			3 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = kochi } }
			3 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = oriya } }
		}
	}
	$region$ = {
		limit = { is_empty = yes }
		random_list = {
			5 = { change_culture = assamese }
			15 = { change_culture = bengali }
			6 = { change_culture = chin }
			8 = { change_culture = garjati }
			4 = { change_culture = gondi }
			3 = { change_culture = jharkhandi }
			3 = { change_culture = kochi }
			3 = { change_culture = oriya }
		}
	}
}

dst_shake_draw_culture_from_iberia = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { capital_scope = { region = $region$ } }
		random_list = {
			15 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = andalucian } }
			4 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = aragonese } }
			3 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = asturian } }
			12 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = castillian } }
			12 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = catalan } }
			5 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = galician } }
			5 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = leonese } }
			5 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = portugese } }
		}
	}
	$region$ = {
		limit = { is_empty = yes }
		random_list = {
			15 = { change_culture = andalucian }
			4 = { change_culture = aragonese }
			3 = { change_culture = asturian }
			12 = { change_culture = castillian }
			12 = { change_culture = catalan }
			5 = { change_culture = galician }
			5 = { change_culture = leonese }
			5 = { change_culture = portugese }
		}
	}
}
dst_shake_draw_culture_from_italy = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { capital_scope = { region = $region$ } }
		random_list = {
			3 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = ligurian } }
			7 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = lombard } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = neapolitan } }
			4 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = piedmontese } }
			6 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = romagnan } }
			4 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = sardinian } }
			5 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = sicilian } }
			5 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = tuscan } }
			7 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = umbrian } }
			5 = { dst_shake_set_culture = { value = venetian } }
		}
	}
	$region$ = {
		limit = { is_empty = yes }
		random_list = {
			3 = { change_culture = ligurian }
			7 = { change_culture = lombard }
			10 = { change_culture = neapolitan }
			4 = { change_culture = piedmontese }
			6 = { change_culture = romagnan }
			4 = { change_culture = sardinian }
			5 = { change_culture = sicilian }
			5 = { change_culture = tuscan }
			7 = { change_culture = umbrian }
			5 = { change_culture = venetian }
		}
	}
}

dst_shake_resolve_culture_via_india = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_india_src_east_indies } dst_shake_pick_culture_from_east_indies = { region = $region$ } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_india_src_oceania } dst_shake_pick_culture_from_oceania = { region = $region$ } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_india_src_china } dst_shake_pick_culture_from_china = { region = $region$ } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_india_src_europe } dst_shake_pick_culture_from_europe = { region = $region$ } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_india_src_eastern_europe } dst_shake_pick_culture_from_eastern_europe = { region = $region$ } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_india_src_tartary } dst_shake_pick_culture_from_tartary = { region = $region$ } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_india_src_far_east } dst_shake_pick_culture_from_far_east = { region = $region$ } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_india_src_africa } dst_shake_pick_culture_from_africa = { region = $region$ } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_india_src_southern_africa } dst_shake_pick_culture_from_southern_africa = { region = $region$ } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_india_src_south_america } dst_shake_pick_culture_from_south_america = { region = $region$ } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_india_src_andes } dst_shake_pick_culture_from_andes = { region = $region$ } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_india_src_north_america } dst_shake_pick_culture_from_north_america = { region = $region$ } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_india_src_central_america } dst_shake_pick_culture_from_central_america = { region = $region$ } }

	else_if = { limit = { has_global_flag = dst_shake_culture_bleed_poland_europe } dst_shake_resolve_culture_via_europe = { region = poland_region } }
	else = { dst_shake_resolve_culture_via_eastern_europe = { region = poland_region } }
}

dst_shake_draw_religion_from_bengal = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { capital_scope = { region = $region$ } }
		random_list = {
			46 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = hinduism } }
		}
	}
	$region$ = {
		limit = { is_empty = yes }
		random_list = {
			46 = { change_religion = hinduism }
		}
	}
}

dst_shake_lost_faith_same_group_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { religion_group = asian_pagan }
		random_list = {
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = zun_pagan_reformed } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { religion_group = christian }
		random_list = {
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = anglican } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = fraticelli } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = iconoclast } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = messalian } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = monophysite } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = monothelite } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = paulician } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = protestant } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = reformed } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { religion_group = dharmic }
		random_list = {
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = sikhism } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { religion_group = european_pagan }
		random_list = {
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = hellenic_pagan } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = solar_monism } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { religion_group = jewish_group }
		random_list = {
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = karaite_faith } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = samaritan_faith } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { religion_group = muslim }
		random_list = {
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = hurufi } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = kharijite } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = yazidi } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = zikri } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { religion_group = zoroastrian_group }
		random_list = {
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = khurmazta } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = manichean } }
			10 = { dst_shake_set_religion = { value = mazdaki } }
		}
	}
}
